name: bento-grid
title: Bento Grid
description: Bento grid is a layout used to showcase the features of a product in a simple and elegant way.

examples.name: bento-grid-demo
examples.title: Features
examples.description: Cards with live backgrounds: Marquee, Animated List and Orbiting Circles.

examples.name: bento-grid-vertical
examples.title: Vertical
examples.description: Place cards on an explicit grid with `lg:row-*` / `lg:col-*` classes.

examples.name: bento-grid-compact
examples.title: Compact
examples.description: Override the row height and column count through `className`.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the grid. Defaults to three columns with 22rem rows (`auto-rows-[22rem] grid-cols-3`).

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card — usually its `col-span-*` / `row-*` placement.

props.name: Icon
props.description: Icon component, e.g. from `lucide-react`. Rendered with `className` applied.

props.name: cta
props.description: Call-to-action label, revealed on hover on large screens.

props.name: background
props.description: Decorative content behind the text. Position it `absolute`.
